name: Conductor
driveConcurrencyNote: How many real claude_cli.invoke dispatches (task_runner's sweep, dispatch.py's instant handoff, and resume_actuator alike) may be open at the same time, enforced atomically at services/dispatch_guard.py's try_begin chokepoint. Default 1 matches the local inference engine's own --parallel 1 (services/local-inference/launch.sh) -- it serves one request at a time, so more concurrent dispatches only pile claude -p processes onto the host without any of them making faster progress (task 8ddbba7f, 2026-09-13).
